description: This file defines the Permission entity class used in access control within the application, including its properties, annotations for persistence, and relationships with the Group entity.

classes.name: Permission
classes.description: Represents a permission entity with properties such as permission name, associated groups, and audit information, mapped to the PERMISSION table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the permission.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the permission.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Retrieves audit information associated with the permission.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit information for the permission.

methods.name: getPermissionName
methods.description: Gets the name of the permission.

methods.name: setPermissionName
methods.description: Sets the name of the permission.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns the list of groups associated with this permission.

methods.name: setGroups
methods.description: Sets the list of groups associated with this permission.
